titleEn: How Much Does a Garage Renovation Cost in Metro Vancouver (2026)? Real Prices, Permits & What You Get for Your Money
titleZh: 2026年大溫哥華車庫裝修費用：真實價格、許可證要求與性價比分析
contentEn:
A attached garage renovation in Metro Vancouver typically costs between $22,000 and $85,000 in 2026, depending on scope. A basic cosmetic refresh runs $22,000–$35,000. Converting the garage into a legal suite or liveable space costs $55,000–$85,000 or more, since it triggers secondary suite permitting, mechanical upgrades, and inspections. These figures come from actual Reno Stars project costs in Delta, Richmond, and Vancouver in 2025–2026.

2026 Garage Renovation Cost Breakdown in Metro Vancouver

Prices vary significantly based on what you are doing with the space. Here is what you can expect to pay in the current Metro Vancouver market:

  • Basic cosmetic renovation (paint, flooring, lighting, garage door replacement): $22,000–$35,000
  • Mid-range renovation (adds insulation, drywall, upgraded electrical, built-in storage): $35,000–$55,000
  • Full conversion to habitable space or secondary suite (mechanical, plumbing, insulation, permitting, inspections): $55,000–$85,000+
  • Detached garage build (new construction, not a renovation): $80,000–$150,000+

These are all-in costs including labour and materials, based on Reno Stars quotes in Delta, Richmond, Coquitlam, and Vancouver from 2025–2026. Prices do not include design fees or structural engineering reports, which add $2,000–$6,000 where required.

Do You Need a Permit for a Garage Renovation in BC?

You almost certainly need a permit. In Metro Vancouver municipalities, any work that alters the structure, adds plumbing, adds electrical circuits beyond a simple plug swap, or changes the use of the space requires a building permit. The City of Vancouver, City of Surrey, City of Richmond, and City of Coquitlam all require separate permits for the building work and for any electrical or plumbing changes.

If you are converting the garage into a secondary suite, you additionally need a City of Vancouver secondary suite permit (or equivalent in your municipality), which triggers utility upgrades, separate metering, and a final inspection from your building inspector. This process alone can take 8–16 weeks.

What Does Each Garage Renovation Tier Include?

Basic cosmetic ($22K–$35K): Exterior and interior paint, epoxy or polished concrete floor, LED pot lights, new garage door and opener, basic shelving. No structural changes, no insulation added.

Mid-range ($35K–$55K): Everything in basic, plus wall and ceiling insulation to R-20, drywall finishing, dedicated 20-amp electrical circuit for tools or EV charger, flush-mount lighting, built-in cabinet storage. This is the most common scope for homeowners who use the garage as a workshop or gym.

Full habitable conversion ($55K–$85K+): Everything above, plus a HRV or mini-split heating system, plumbing for a sink or future bathroom rough-in, 100-amp electrical service upgrade (often required), full permit package, and final inspections. If you are building a secondary suite, you also need a kitchen rough-in which adds $8,000–$15,000.

Real Reno Stars Project: Garage Interior in Delta

Reno Stars recently completed a mid-range garage interior renovation in Delta for a homeowner who wanted to convert their attached garage from a dark, uninsulated storage space into a functional workshop and gym. The project included new insulation, drywall, epoxy flooring, dedicated EV charging circuit, LED lighting, and built-in wall cabinets. The client stayed within the $42,000 mid-range budget.

Planning a similar project? Browse Reno Stars projects in Delta to see the quality of finish in adjacent scope work, or our Vancouver whole-house renovation to understand our process before you start.

How Long Does a Garage Renovation Take?

A basic cosmetic garage renovation takes 2–4 weeks. A mid-range project takes 4–8 weeks. A full habitable conversion or secondary suite renovation takes 10–20 weeks in Metro Vancouver, driven almost entirely by the permit timelines in your municipality.

City of Vancouver secondary suite permits currently run 8–16 weeks for review alone. Richmond and Surrey are typically faster at 4–8 weeks for standard building permits.

BC Building Code Requirements for Garage Conversions

If you are converting an attached garage into habitable space, BC Building Code 2024 requires:

  • Wall and ceiling insulation minimum R-20 (new climate zone requirements)
  • Air barrier and vapour barrier throughout
  • Smoke and CO2 alarms hardwired and interconnected
  • Mechanical ventilation meeting ASHRAE 62.2 (typically an HRV orERV)
  • Separation from the house by a fire-rated wall with a self-closing, self-latching door

These requirements apply regardless of municipality. Your building inspector will verify all of these on final inspection.

Garage Renovation FAQs

Can I convert my attached garage to a living space without a permit in BC?

No. Any work that changes the use of the space, adds insulation, or modifies mechanical systems requires a building permit in every Metro Vancouver municipality. Doing work without a permit can result in fines, mandatory demolition, and complications when you sell your home.

Does renovating my garage increase my property taxes in BC?

Yes. Any renovation that adds floor area or increases the assessed value of your home will be reassessed by BC Assessment after the renovation. A garage-to-suite conversion in particular can significantly increase your assessment because it adds a self-contained residential unit.

Can I do a garage renovation in a strata property?

If you live in a townhouse or condo strata, you need written approval from the strata council before any renovation that affects the exterior or structural elements. Interior-only cosmetic work may be permitted, but always check your strata bylaws first.

Is it worth renovating an attached garage vs. building a detached one?

If you need the parking, renovating the attached garage is significantly cheaper (no new foundation, no new roof, existing structure). If you do not need the parking and want a dedicated workspace or suite, a detached garage build gives you complete flexibility but costs 3–5 times more. Many homeowners in Richmond and North Vancouver choose the attached renovation route first.

contentZh:
2026年，大溫哥華附屬車庫裝修的典型費用為22,000至85,000加元，具體取決於工程範圍。基本美化翻新費用為22,000至35,000加元。將車庫改建為合法套房或居住空間，費用則高達55,000至85,000加元以上，因為需要申請套房許可證、機械升級及驗收。這些數據均來自Reno Stars在三角洲、列治文及溫哥華2025至2026年的實際工程費用。

2026年大溫哥華車庫裝修費用明細

費用取決於工程範圍，以下是當前大溫哥華市場的預期價格：

  • 基本美化翻新（油漆、地面、照明、車庫門更換）：22,000–35,000加元
  • 中檔裝修（新增隔熱、乾牆、電路升級、嵌入式儲物）：35,000–55,000加元
  • 全面改建為居住空間或第二套房（機電、管道、保溫、許可證、驗收）：55,000–85,000加元以上
  • 新建獨立車庫（非裝修的新建工程）：80,000–150,000加元以上

以上均為包含人工及材料的總價，數據來源於Reno Stars在三角洲、列治文、高貴林及溫哥華2025至2026年的報價。設計費及結構工程報告另計，約需額外2,000至6,000加元。

BC省車庫裝修是否需要許可證？

幾乎肯定需要許可證。在大溫哥華各城市，任何涉及結構變動、增設管道、新增電路（除簡單插座更換外）或改變空間用途的工程，均需申請建築許可證。溫哥華市、素里市、列治文市及高貴林市均要求分別申請建築工程許可證及水電許可證。

若將車庫改建為第二套房，還需額外申請溫哥華市第二套房許可證（或其他城市的同等許可證），這會觸發公用設施升級、獨立錶箱及最終驗收，整個流程可能需要8至16週。

各檔次車庫裝修包含哪些項目？

基本美化（22K–35K加元）：內外牆油漆、環氧樹酯或拋光混凝土地面、LED筒燈、全新車庫門及開門機、基礎儲物架。無結構改造，無新增隔熱。

中檔裝修（35K–55K加元）：基本款所有項目，加上牆體及天花板R-20隔熱、乾牆飾面、20安培專用電路（供工具或電動車充电器使用）、嵌入式牆櫃。這是將車庫作為工作室或健身房的業主最常選擇的方案。

全面居住空間改建（55K–85K加元以上）：以上全部項目，加上HRV或迷你分體式供暖系統、排水管道預留、100安培電箱升級（通常為強制要求）、完整許可證文件包及最終驗收。若改建為第二套房，還需廚房管道預留，另加8,000至15,000加元。

Reno Stars真實工程案例：三角洲車庫室內裝修

Reno Stars最近在三角洲完成了一個中檔車庫室內裝修工程，業主希望將附屬車庫從陰暗、無隔熱的儲物空間改造為功能齊全的工作室及健身房。工程包括新增隔熱、乾牆、環氧樹酯地面、專用電動車充電電路、LED照明及嵌入式牆櫃。客戶最終費用控制在42,000加元的中檔預算範圍內。

歡迎了解更多Reno Stars在三角洲的工程案例，或瀏覽我們的溫哥華整體房屋裝修工程，了解我們的施工標準及流程，再開始您的裝修計劃。

車庫裝修需要多長時間？

基本美化車庫裝修需2至4週。中檔工程需4至8週。全面居住空間改建或第二套房工程需10至20週，大溫哥華地區主要延誤來自許可證審批流程。

溫哥華市第二套房許可證目前僅審批就需要8至16週。列治文及素里市的標準建築許可證通常較快，約4至8週。

BC省建築規範對車庫改建的要求

若將附屬車庫改建為居住空間，BC省2024年建築規範要求：

  • 牆體及天花板最低R-20隔熱（新氣候區要求）
  • 全範圍氣密屏障及防潮層
  • 煙霧及一氧化碳警報器硬線連接並互聯
  • 符合ASHRAE 62.2標準的機械通風（通常為HRV或ERV）
  • 與主屋之間設耐火牆，配置自動關閉自動上鎖門

以上要求適用於所有城市，最終驗收時建築督察會逐項核查。

車庫裝修常見問題

在不列顛哥倫比亞省，我可以不申請許可證就將車庫改為居住空間嗎？

不行。任何改變空間用途、增設隔熱或改動機電系統的工程，在大溫哥華每個城市都需要申請建築許可證。無許可證施工可能導致罰款、強制拆除及售房時的麻煩。

車庫裝修會增加不列顛哥倫比亞省的房產稅嗎？

會。任何增加建築面積或提高評估價值的裝修工程，在裝修後都會被BC省評估局重新評估。車庫改建為套房尤其會大幅提高評估值，因為這等於新增了一個獨立住宅單元。

共管資產（Strata）住宅可以進行車庫裝修嗎？

如果您住在聯排別墅或公寓Strata小區，任何影響外觀或結構構件的裝修工程都需要獲得Strata管理委員會的書面批准。室內美化工程可能獲批，但請務必先查閱您的Strata章程。

附屬車庫裝修與新建獨立車庫，哪個更值得？

如果您需要保留車位，附屬車庫裝修費用低得多（無需新地基、無需新屋頂、現有結構）。如果您不需要車位，希望擁有獨立工作室或套房，新建獨立車庫則提供完全靈活性，但造價高出3至5倍。列治文及北溫哥華的許多業主會先選擇附屬車庫裝修方案。
